scope: Lean constructs all-time, two-parameter unitary evolution for continuous bounded skew-adjoint operators on any complete complex Hilbert space, including composition, backward evolution, joint continuity and unique state solutions. The concrete regularized homogeneous Yosida Hamiltonians supply the generator; for nonzero hbar the states solve the bounded Schrodinger equation. A generic stability estimate bounds evolution differences by a supplied bound on the generator residual along the second trajectory; decay of that residual is not proved. These finite Gaussian computations check transcription only. Convergence as cutoff tends to infinity, the unbounded propagator, the full six-mode infinite model, regulator removal, physical identification and TOE remain open.
